name: RDP Pivot Average (Primitive)
description: Anchor-structure indicator that averages the last N RDP pivot prices, plots each rolling average at the newest pivot, and connects those averages as a chart baseline.
author: system

tunable_params.label: Pivot Average Window
tunable_params.description: Number of consecutive RDP pivot prices to average into each plotted baseline point.

tunable_params.label: RDP Epsilon
tunable_params.description: RDP sensitivity as a fraction of price range. Higher values keep fewer, larger pivots.

tunable_params.label: Use Exact Epsilon
tunable_params.description: When enabled, bypasses adaptive RDP epsilon selection and uses the configured epsilon directly.

tunable_params.label: Pivot Source
tunable_params.description: auto prefers precomputed structure pivots when available, otherwise runs RDP fresh.

tunable_params.label: Lookback Window
tunable_params.description: Only use RDP pivots inside the last N bars.

tunable_params.label: Show RDP Path
tunable_params.description: Draw the underlying RDP pivot path as a dashed reference line.

tunable_params.label: Extend To Latest Bar
tunable_params.description: Extend the latest pivot average horizontally to the current bar so the baseline remains visible at the chart edge.

tunable_params.label: Signal Direction
tunable_params.description: Backtest signal mode: close crossing above or below the current RDP pivot average baseline.
